text: Skimmed milk is heated to a chosen class, boiled down to about half solids under vacuum and sprayed into hot air to a dry powder.

steps.note: The milk is heated to a chosen class: low-heat 75 °C for 15 s, medium-heat 90–100 °C for 20 s, high-heat 120 °C for 120 s, or heat-stable high-heat 125 °C for 180 s.
The milk is sprayed into hot air of 200–230 °C, and the air leaves at 80–85 °C.
